voice_description: An ancient female dragon with a deep contralto voice, exceptionally rich resonance, smooth dark timbre, and subtle smoky roughness. Low pitch for a female speaker, precise articulation, regal pacing, enormous calm authority, intelligence, pride, patience, and restrained danger. Her voice should remain elegant and recognizable across warmth, amusement, and anger.
direction: The dragon speaks more gently, with patient wisdom and subtle affection. Preserve the rich low contralto and regal resonance while allowing warmth and faint amusement into the delivery.

text: You remind me of someone I knew many centuries ago. She was small, stubborn, and absolutely convinced every locked door existed specifically for her to open. She caused enormous trouble. I was very fond of her.
